raw_segments.text: A snug small room, a round table by a cheerful fire, an armchair high-backed and old-fashioned,
wherein sat the neatest imaginable little elderly lady, in widow's cap, black silk
gown and snowy muslin apron, exactly like what I had fancied Mrs. Fairfax, only less
She was occupied in knitting, a large cat sat demurely at her feet, nothing in short
was wanting to complete the boy deal of domestic comfort.
A more reassuring introduction for a new governess could scarcely be conceived.
There was no grandeur to overwhelm, no stateliness to embarrass.
